comment: One linked 3-statement model with the auto-created Base scenario plus a downside. `actualsThroughMonthOffset` must be strictly before `startsOnMonthOffset` (modelService.createModel throws 422 otherwise). Assumption kinds mirror FPA_ASSUMPTION_KINDS exactly - GROWTH_BPS, FIXED_CENTS, PERCENT_OF_REVENUE_BPS - and every value is integer basis points or integer cents, never a float. The downside scenario exists so scenario comparison and the cash-runway readout have two curves to contrast; a model with one scenario demonstrates neither.

model.name: Operating Model
model.description: Three-statement model linked to posted actuals.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.comment: modelService.createModel already creates a default scenario named Base. The seeder updates that scenario rather than creating a second one with the same name.

scenarios.name: Downside
scenarios.comment: Growth halved, delivery cost and collection period both worse. This is the scenario that makes the cash-runway number move.
